profile.headline: Software Engineer  |   Blazor/.NET/Azure  |  React/Node/AWS  |  Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
profile.summary:
As a full-stack software engineer proficient in both React/Node/AWS and Blazor/.NET/Azure stacks, I specialize in delivering scalable, high-impact solutions. My experience spans front-end development with React and Blazor, back-end development with .NET (Core, MVC) and Node.js, advanced database management with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and DynamoDB, and hosting/deployment with AWS and Azure. With expertise in data visualization, I enjoy leveraging tools like Stimulsoft, Chart.js and Telerik to create dynamic dashboards that inform key decisions.

As a Tech Lead at Trifoia Inc., I led the modernization of a CDC-funded health app transitioning from a Node/AWS app to a .NET/Azure app, cutting maintenance costs by over 50%. 

As a full stack software engineer at Local Foods Marketplace, I developed an API that integrated USDA and state-specific food subsidy programs into the existing checkout process, generating new revenue streams for over 150 vendors across North America.

Currently, I am self-employed with several clients. 

I have a strong work ethic and maintain a growth mindset. If you're looking for a software engineer who combines technical expertise with leadership and a focus on innovation, let’s connect. I’m always open to new opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Lead Associate
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Volunteer Firefighter and Public Information Officer
positions.description:
- Deliver fire and basic medical services for Breitenbush Hot Springs, Devil's Creek Summer Homes, and surrounding Forest Service and Department of Forestry lands.
- Led the successful emergency evacuation of over 100 individuals during the Santiam Fire, which devastated over 400,000 acres, including two nearby towns (Detroit and Gates) and 70+ structures in and around Breitenbush Hot Springs.
- As Search and Rescue Team Captain, coordinated and oversaw search and rescue efforts for lost hikers several times a year; planned and led quarterly team trainings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Created CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions to automate deployment of Node and .NET apps to both AWS and Azure, reducing version release time by around 90%.
- Collaborated closely with international developers to develop cart feature using .NET Core, Azure, SQL Server, Entity Framework (code-first approach) and Blazor; activities included building API integrations for TalentLMS and Stripe, adding styling and UI components, and debugging.
- Leveraged React, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework and SQL Server to seamlessly integrate a federal payment processing API for food e-commerce platform, providing additional income for clients across North America.
- Followed MVC pattern to develop subscription and bundle-based ordering features using React, C# and Razor, creating recurring revenue streams for more than 120 businesses in the U.S. and Canada.
- Generated data models from existing database schema using Entity Framework, facilitating data access and a database-first development approach; implemented stored procedures for performance optimization and security.
- Discovered root cause of reoccurring rounding errors that plagued payment processing feature for months.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS SDK · Microsoft Azure · Blazor · Oqtane

positions.title: Tech Lead, Engineer
positions.description:
- Led migration of CDC-funded family health app from legacy technologies (JavaScript, Node.js, Express, DynamoDB, AWS) to a .NET application hosted in Azure; utilized Blazor, Oqtane, Blazorise and SQL Server, providing a more responsive UI while improving performance and reducing maintenance costs by over 50%.
- Responsible for updates and hosting of .NET app which integrated a WordPress site hosted in AWS; utilized GraphQL to expose xAPI information from LearnDash LMS to .Net app.
- Responsible for maintenance, bug fixes and occasional new features several JavaScript (EJS)/Node.js apps hosted on AWS (EC2, Linux); utilized Docker for unit tests.
- Interfaced directly with clients to conduct needs assessments and production support.
- Responsible for approving PRs, pushing up schema changes, and pushing builds to all environments.
- Assisted in build out of xAPI statement reporting and management of customized Rise (Articulate) Packages.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
positions.description:
- Leveraged AWS SDK and CDK with DynamoDB and Node API layer to build and maintain backend for national-level adult education app funded by United States Agency for International Development.
- Implemented Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK to automate provisioning of AWS services (CloudFront, EC2, S3, Gateway, Cognito, Lambda, Route53, DynamoDB) for scalable, responsive EdTech app (Vue/Node/Postgres) funded by the US State Dept., reducing the time needed to deploy new instances and versions of the app to 10 minutes.
- Maintained DevOps support on Linux Servers (hosted on EC2 instances) for all active company projects.
- Assisted with front end development using Vue and assisted in architecture decision making.
- Responsible for maintenance, bug fixes and occasional new features several JavaScript (EJS)/Node.js apps hosted on AWS (EC2, Linux); utilized Docker for unit tests.

positions.title: Director of Marketing, Events & Hospitality
positions.description:
- Managed daily operations and communications for education, conference and retreat center with over 38,000 guest nights per year; contributed to 9% profitability increase.
‒ Developed email marketing and social media channels including Facebook (28k followers) and Instagram (250% increase in followers in 8 months).
‒ Responsible for organizational-level outgoing communications and Internet presence.
‒ Used Google Analytics to guide development of sitemap and reservation system UX.
‒ Led the search for and prototyping of new online reservation system.
‒ Provided supervision and direct support for all guest-facing teams (~40 staff).
‒ Editor-in-chief for biannual, color catalog and Breitenbush Cookbook.
‒ Used Photoshop to develop postcards and ads, and prepare photos for print materials.
‒ Trained staff in transition from legacy systems to Google Suite.
‒ Developed tracking and reporting systems for guest feedback and issues.
‒ Responsible for curation and top-level management of over 150 workshops annually.
‒ Served as Breitenbush liaison for agencies such as U.S. Forest Service, Oregon Dept. of Forestry, Marion County Sheriff, Oregon Health Authority and others.
‒ Established Breitenbush Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Working Group.
‒ Managed staff training: values mapping, mediation, group process, facilitation and DEI.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Data Analysis · Online Marketing · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Statistical Data Analysis · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Leadership · Project Management · Report Writing · Business Analytics · Reporting & Analysis · Social Media Marketing

- Coordinated and tracked product features among design, engineering and architecture teams for flagship IEG products, Immersive Shopping and Replay (Intel True View).
- Developed competitive analysis for Immersive Shopping, guiding product development.
- Facilitated five user studies for Intel 3D camera; findings used to identify defects and improve user experience.
- Analyzed quantitative performance data for 3D camera and report out to product teams.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Responsible for client-side database management, project evaluation and progress reporting for international, $1.2M dollar, USAID-funded Feed the Future program.
- Surveyed residents and developed 'social' cost benefit analysis for the reopening of Ha'iku Stairs (a.k.a. Stairway to Heaven) to the public; results presented to the City and County of Honolulu.
- Worked closely with cross-functional, global teams to develop enterprise budget model to measure the profitability of food production systems in Nepal; results serve as baseline for ongoing research (published).
- Authored book chapter on Albania’s agricultural markets; offered key recommendations for stimulating growth in the sector (published).
- Managed survey-based data collection using Analytic Hierarchy Process to quantify stakeholder preferences for technology adoption; trained 60 colleagues (published).

- Developed multi-objective optimization model using soil, yield and market data to predict social benefit of conservation agriculture adoption among tribal farmers in India; estimated state-level economic impact; model adopted for use in Nepal (published).
